speaker: lumi
text: Wait... did that apple just fall up?

speaker: draco
text: Easy! I understand time magic. Watch this!

speaker: bobo
text: I think this forest needs a clock repairman!

speaker: tock
text: You're late! You're early! You're... yesterday!

speaker: tock
text: I'm Tock, guardian of the tower. The Master Clock has stopped!

speaker: kiko
text: So... what time is it?

speaker: tock
text: Banana o'clock!

speaker: bobo
text: Banana o'clock?!

speaker: bobo
text: Why does everyone keep seeing me do that?!

speaker: draco
text: Ta-da! ...Huh? Where did everyone go?

speaker: tock
text: The clock lost its two hands! One is in the Gear Garden, one in the Pendulum Chamber.

speaker: tock
text: Hurry! It's half past Thursday!

speaker: lumi
text: Bobo, that's a clock hand!

speaker: bobo
text: Well, it looks delicious!

speaker: tock
text: I've never fixed it alone... what if I break time?

speaker: lumi
text: You're not alone, Tock. We're right here!

speaker: tock
text: Hands up... and... TICK!

speaker: bobo
text: Finally! It's banana o'clock!

speaker: tock
text: Oh no! We're late for tomorrow!

speaker: bobo
text: Not this time, Kiko!

speaker: lumi
text: Another mystery! Come on, friends. Our next adventure is waiting!

speaker: narrator
text: Next time... the mystery of the rainbow bridge!
